I can see the issue! The doc-embedder pod is stuck in Pending with the reason "Unschedulable". The pod scheduling condition shows two problems:
1. 3 nodes had an untolerated taint `{dedicated: gpu}`
2. 6 nodes didn't match the pod's node selector

The pod has a toleration for `nvidia.com/gpu` but NOT for the `dedicated: gpu` taint. Let me search the Kubernetes documentation to confirm the proper way to handle taints and tolerations.
